description: Security Papers Limited was established in 1965 and became a joint venture of Iran, Turkey and Pakistan in 1967 under the RCD — now ECO — protocol. Its business, then and now, is the manufacture of banknote paper and other security paper, produced at its mill on Jinnah Avenue, Malir Halt, Karachi.
headOffice: Jinnah Avenue, Malir Halt, Karachi 75100, Pakistan
